core_obligations: Set up the solid lifting diagram for f|_U : U -> V with a first-order thickening T' of T.
Apply formal smoothness of f to obtain the S-morphism a' : T' -> X extending a.
Show a' factors through U because T and T' share the same underlying space, and that it is a V-morphism.
Conclude that the dotted lifting arrow exists, i.e. f|_U is formally smooth.

proof_roadmap.step: Produce the lift into X from formal smoothness of f.
Factor the lift through U and conclude formal smoothness of the restriction.

difficulty_reason: If f : X -> S is formally smooth, then its restriction U -> V to open subschemes with f(U) contained in V is formally smooth. The proof runs the lifting definition directly: given a solid diagram with a first-order thickening, formal smoothness of f produces an S-morphism T' -> X extending the given map; since T and T' have the same underlying topological space, the lift factors through the open U, and it is a V-morphism because the diagram commutes. Retained author proof at lines 3147-3161.
